issues.title: P1: Publish nullable native validation references in the OpenAPI 3.0 artifact
issues.description:
Candidate artifact preparation at `79f36cfd4d0d33af34ce4a07979c5195b149ba99` found `scripts/update-native-task-openapi.mjs` rejects the native task validationSelection schema's `oneOf: [null, $ref]` with Unsupported nullable OpenAPI union. This prevents generating the current public contract, including closed-task archival. Fresh Node22 clone build succeeded; generation failed before writing any artifact. No earlier acceptance is declared false by this preparation result.

Implement a valid OpenAPI 3.0 representation preserving referenced object constraints and nullability, regenerate only in a candidate clone, and cover null/non-null shapes without loosening runtime validation. Link to <issue id="3d3b9f2d-2301-4637-a66c-8a13bec5120f" href="https://linear.app/agentmaturitycompass/issue/AMC-1538/p1-distinguish-native-task-completion-from-operator-defined-validation">AMC-1538</issue> and <issue id="0ab82ae7-e254-44bf-ab52-114248425567" href="https://linear.app/agentmaturitycompass/issue/AMC-1541/p1-archive-closed-native-studio-task-descriptors-without-deleting">AMC-1541</issue>. Done requires the standing fresh merged-candidate acceptance/full suite/release-gate/record requirements. Failure log: `AMC_OS/RESEARCH/2026-09-09-api-reference-recovery/candidate-generation.log`.

issues.title: P1: Stop publishing source test inventory as passing execution results
issues.description:
Current scripts/gen-counts.mjs converts regex matches of direct it()/test() calls into public 'passing tests' claims across10 prose/website surfaces. This is source inventory, not an executed result. Disposable reproduction: generator --check passes before any tests, then also passes after Vitest reports2 passed/1failed/1skipped while README claims1passing test. Full AMC baseline independently ran10,932 passing tests at4247e610; those are distinct metrics.

Acceptance: publish the existing testFiles metric as test source files (or remove numeric outcome wording), keep regex testBlocks only as described internal inventory, retain CI result links, and make --check reject unqualified numerical passing labels even when numbers match. Update generator/templates/consumer prose and publicStatsDrift expectations; preserve historical audit snapshots. Meaningful fixture: correct numeric passing badge must fail; correct source inventory passes without running tests; --write repairs stale inventory and is idempotent. Focused counts suites and built count check pass. Do not replace static metrics with an unbound/stale passing number or invent coverage.

Scope/plan: AMC_OS/RESEARCH/2026-09-08-dsh-pi/test-count-claim-plan.md. Documentation and count tooling follow-through during AMC1525 final qualification; product runtime remains one implementation issue at a time.

The active shared checkout now also contains an unrelated uncommitted packaging test, so its inventory will need regeneration when that change lands. This does not turn either number into a passing-test result.

Full-suite follow-through also corrected command metadata to 1,180 paths, regenerated the API reference, routed public architecture links through CODE_GRAPH, and promoted the KEY_HISTORY operator guide (175 public guides). Thirteen focused docs/metadata/artifact tests and generated API check pass. Historical records remain unchanged. Evidence: public-docs-qualification-repair.md under the dated research directory. issues.title: P1: Report persona QA as automated contract evidence with truthful failed-check feedback
issues.description:
At bd781be5, scripts/install-persona-qa.mjs computes rating as passed checks / total *10 and presents it as an ease-of-use rating. personaFeedback only reads command steps, not contract assertions: an install with missing full-score output can be described as 'acceptable first score' even when the score-contract assertion fails. Pure-function reproduction is recorded in the September harness usability audit. This is misleading qualification evidence, not a measured human usability result.

Acceptance:

* Replace ambiguous UX rating/claims with labeled automated contract pass counts, measured timings, explicit unknowns and failed assertions.
* Failed required assertions appear in the persona summary, even when the command exited zero; missing score data never implies acceptable first use.
* Separate actual human/paired-task usability measurements tracked under <issue id="42ff0b98-0548-4d3d-b404-f0b58850ad97" href="https://linear.app/agentmaturitycompass/issue/AMC-1518/p1-measure-amc-dsh-and-pi-on-reproducible-task-and-governance">AMC-1518</issue> from automated checks.
* Preserve structured report consumers through explicit schema evolution or documented backward-compatible deprecation.
* Verify malformed/missing score, assertion-only failure, slow install and all-pass cases; review emitted Markdown/JSON.

Reuse <issue id="6683c98e-618b-407d-894c-8cd71b53ad20" href="https://linear.app/agentmaturitycompass/issue/AMC-483/audit-align-release-gate-ci-bundle-scan-and-clean-install-qa">AMC-483</issue> for environment isolation and release-gate integration; do not duplicate it here. Current automated checks are valuable contract smoke tests once labeled correctly.

Implementation started after release script review. Read-only design at 6553906e reproduces null strategy/import output silently removing required assertions and still reporting 10/10. Plan registers mandatory checks before execution, records skipped dependencies without shrinking totals, validates required output, separates command wall time from CLI-reported diagnostic elapsed, and replaces ratings with versioned automated-contract-checks counts. Independent consumer inventory found only the producer/renderer reading rating fields; release gate consumes process status. Historical dated ratings remain unchanged. Design: AMC_OS/RESEARCH/2026-09-08-dsh-pi/persona-contract-result-design.md. Current 103 planned checks is a computed design inventory, not a passing result.

Local implementation committed95aa5e80. Final four-file aggregate e8227d5c9b230813a714084f1dd498e0707cd602aedf90c8df02990ee43f9eed; owner35/35 focused and independent24/24 affected results pass (overlapping, not additive). Root actual corrected main performs ten real npm installs and fixture CLI workflows against pinned6553906e package:103/103 persona checks +2/2 setup, zero failed/skipped, exit0. Final script hashc1f410b3a8fe9e04e10b5eb5794adf0de423dff683aa260c028dfe1ed1eb12c9 unchanged. All ten results distinguish artifactVALID, evidenceINSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and claimEligible=false. Root initial actual report caught a mislabeled validity column; corrected producer-shaped regression and both historical/updated receipts are preserved. New2026-09-08 schema removes human ratings/feedback, keeps missing data explicit and wall/internal timing separate. Receipt: persona-contract-results/actual-6553906e-corrected/README.md. Combined full candidate gate remains pending; In Review is local acceptance, not publication or human usability validation.
